en.text: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

footnotes.text: 94:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你是伸冤的 神；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你是伸冤的上帝；

en.text: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

zhSimplified.text: 审判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，

zhTraditional.text: 審判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，

en.text: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，惡人誇勝要到幾時呢？

en.text: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

zhSimplified.text: 他们絮絮叨叨说傲慢的话；

zhTraditional.text: 他們絮絮叨叨說傲慢的話；

en.text: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，他們強壓你的百姓，

en.text: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

zhSimplified.text: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的，

zhTraditional.text: 他們殺死寡婦和寄居的，

en.text: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：耶和华必不看见； 的 神必不思念。

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：耶和華必不看見； 的上帝必不思念。

en.text: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

zhSimplified.text: 你们民间的畜类人当思想；

zhTraditional.text: 你們民間的畜類人當思想；

en.text: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

zhSimplified.text: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见吗？

zhTraditional.text: 造耳朵的，難道自己不聽見嗎？

en.text: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

zhSimplified.text: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的，

zhTraditional.text: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知識的，

en.text: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華知道人的意念是虛妄的。

en.text: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你所管教、

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你所管教、

en.text: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 你使他在遭难的日子得享平安；

zhTraditional.text: 你使他在遭難的日子得享平安；

en.text: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓，

zhTraditional.text: 因為耶和華必不丟棄他的百姓，

en.text: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

zhSimplified.text: 审判要转向公义；

zhTraditional.text: 審判要轉向公義；

en.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

zhSimplified.text: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的？

zhTraditional.text: 誰肯為我起來攻擊作惡的？

en.text: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

zhSimplified.text: 若不是耶和华帮助我，

zhTraditional.text: 若不是耶和華幫助我，

en.text: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

zhSimplified.text: 我正说我失了脚，

zhTraditional.text: 我正說我失了腳，

en.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 我心里多忧多疑，

zhTraditional.text: 我心裏多憂多疑，

en.text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

zhSimplified.text: 那借着律例架弄残害、

zhTraditional.text: 那藉着律例架弄殘害、

en.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

zhSimplified.text: 他们大家聚集攻击义人，

zhTraditional.text: 他們大家聚集攻擊義人，

en.text: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

zhSimplified.text: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台；

zhTraditional.text: 但耶和華向來作了我的高臺；

en.text: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

zhSimplified.text: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。

zhTraditional.text: 他叫他們的罪孽歸到他們身上。
